title: Signed line PullbackTensor
statement: Let U preserve finite limits and coverings, let the adjunct of a:R→U_*S be invertible, and fix an isomorphism t:F(L)≅N of module sheaves. There exists a natural isomorphism gamma:(- tensor L)⋙F≅F⋙(- tensor N). On every source pure section x tensor y inserted by the pullback unit, gamma is the pure tensor of the inserted x and t applied to the inserted y. No flatness or rank assumption on L is needed.

source.place: Tags 03D2, 03D3, 03EL and 0FNY; for derived localization use derived.tex Tags 06YU, 07A4 and 015F. Specialization of the Powers and duals paragraph of the current blueprint.

proof.text: Use the finite-limit theorem to obtain the unit-compatible ring and module-set presentations. Construct AlgebraicInverseImage with exactly the specified module pullback and its given comparison. The inverse-image tensor comparison then gives a binary comparison whose unit formula is proved by testing a Cartesian graph.

Conjugate by the ordinary/site tensor comparison and tensor the second factor with t. Its pure-section formula follows from the two comparison formulas and pullback-unit naturality. Prove naturality in the first module by the pullback adjunction and tensor generation, and assemble the component isomorphisms.

proof_origin.place: Powers and duals, including unit, positive tensor recursion, evaluation, and unbounded derived action. The component proof is given below and in the attached Lean module.

theorem identified_ring_pullback_tensor
    [HasFiniteLimits C] [HasFiniteLimits D] [PreservesFiniteLimits U]
    (a : (sheafCompose J (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj R ⟶
      (U.sheafPushforwardContinuous RingCat J K).obj
        ((sheafCompose K (forget₂ CommRingCat RingCat)).obj S))
    (hcover : CoverPreserving J K U)
    (rInv : Sheaf J RingCat.{max u v w} ⥤ Sheaf K RingCat.{max u v w})
    (rAdj : rInv ⊣ U.sheafPushforwardContinuous RingCat J K)
    (ha : IsIso ((rAdj.homEquiv _ _).symm a))
    (L : KFlatFixedTensor.Modules R) (N : KFlatFixedTensor.Modules S)
    (t : (pull a).obj L ≅ N) :
    ∃ γ : siteSheafTensorRight L ⋙ pull a ≅ pull a ⋙ siteSheafTensorRight N,
      ∀ (M : KFlatFixedTensor.Modules R) (V : C) (x : M.val.obj (op V))
        (y : L.val.obj (op V)),
        (γ.hom.app M).val.app (op (U.obj V))
          (ringedSitePullbackSection a (module_pushforward_isRightAdjoint_of_universes a)
            ((siteSheafTensorRight L).obj M) V (siteSheafTensorTmul M L (op V) x y)) =
          siteSheafTensorTmul ((pull a).obj M) N (op (U.obj V))
            (ringedSitePullbackSection a (module_pushforward_isRightAdjoint_of_universes a)
              M V x)
            (t.hom.val.app (op (U.obj V))
              (ringedSitePullbackSection a (module_pushforward_isRightAdjoint_of_universes a)
                L V y))
